Terms of Service

Veyrnox Ltd, trading as Veyrnox.ai. Company no. 17299951. Last updated 16 October 2026.

These terms govern your use of Veyrnox.ai, operated by Veyrnox Ltd, a company registered in England & Wales (company no. 17299951), registered office Suite RA01, 195-197 Wood Street, London, England, E17 3NU. By creating an account or generating content you agree to them.

1. The service

Veyrnox.ai is a credit-metered service for generating images, video and audio with third-party AI models. Every generation shows its credit cost before you confirm. We may add, remove or re-price models at any time; the price shown at the moment you generate is the price you pay.

2. Accounts

  • You must be 18 or over, or the age of majority where you live.
  • Keep your login secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.
  • One account per person. We may suspend accounts that abuse the free-credit grant.

3. Credits

  • New accounts receive 10 free credits. Free credits have no cash value, cannot be withdrawn, are used before purchased credits, and expire 90 days after they are granted if unused.
  • Purchased credits never expire.
  • Purchased credits are debited when a generation is submitted. If the provider fails to complete the generation, the debit is automatically refunded to your balance. See our Refund Policy.
  • Credits are not transferable between accounts.
  • Referral rewards: if a friend joins through your referral link and buys their first credit pack, you may earn credits worth 10% of that pack, added to your balance 14 days after their purchase if it has not been refunded or disputed. Referral credits have no cash value, never expire and are never paid out as money. If that purchase is refunded or disputed after the reward was added, the reward is taken back, up to the purchased credits you still hold. Rewards are limited to 20 and 2,000 credits per calendar month, and we may withhold or reverse a reward for self-referral or abuse.
  • Credit packs are sold through Stripe Checkout. Under Stripe Managed Payments, Stripe, Inc. is the Merchant of Record and the seller of record for your credit pack purchase: Stripe takes the payment, charges and remits any VAT or sales tax due for your location, and issues your receipt. The total including tax is shown before you pay. Veyrnox Ltd provides the Veyrnox.ai service that the credits are spent on, and these terms govern your use of it. Stripe handles your card details; we never see them.
  • Before you buy, you must tick a box confirming: “I want my credits added to my account straight away. I understand that once I use any of these credits to generate, I lose my right to cancel this purchase.” See our Refund Policy.

3A. Credit Subscriptions

  • A Credit Subscription supplies the number of Subscription Credits and charges the weekly or monthly USD price displayed when you subscribe, plus any tax shown at checkout. It renews automatically at the selected interval until you cancel.
  • Subscription Credits are added only after each recurring payment is confirmed. They are used before Free Credits and Credit Pack credits, expire at the end of that paid cycle, and do not roll over. Cancelling renewal does not extend their expiry.
  • You can stop renewal at any time from Credits & billing. You will not be charged for another cycle, and the current paid cycle continues until its displayed end date.
  • For the initial paid cycle, you may request a full cooling-off refund within 14 days only while none of that cycle’s Subscription Credits has been used. If any of those Credits has been used, you can still stop the next renewal. The server checks eligibility and the refund status is not complete until it is confirmed.
  • Before checkout you must expressly accept the recurring price and interval, the number of Credits supplied after each confirmed payment, and the no-rollover expiry. The final price including tax is shown before payment.

3B. Veyrnox.ai Publish Plan

  • The Veyrnox.ai Publish Plan supplies the advanced publishing, analytics and account features shown on the plan page. It charges the weekly, monthly or annual USD price selected before checkout, plus any tax shown at checkout, and renews automatically at that interval until you cancel.
  • You can stop renewal from the Publish Plan page or its Stripe billing portal. You will not be charged for another cycle, and paid features continue until the displayed paid-period end.
  • Before checkout you must expressly accept the recurring price and interval. The final price including tax is shown before payment.

4. Your inputs and outputs

  • You keep whatever rights you hold in the prompts and reference files you upload. You grant us a licence to process them solely to run the service.
  • Subject to these terms and each underlying model provider’s licence, you may use generated outputs for personal and commercial purposes.
  • Outputs are AI-generated. We do not currently attach content credentials or a machine-readable provenance signature to generated files. Where you publish an output, you are responsible for any labelling a platform or applicable law requires of you. If we begin attaching credentials we will say so here, and you must not then remove or alter them.
  • You must not use the service to generate, upload or publish sexually explicit content, unlawful content, content that infringes others’ rights, sexualised content involving minors, non-consensual intimate imagery, sexual deepfakes, malware or content intended to deceive in a way that causes harm.

5. Acceptable use

No scraping, reverse-engineering, rate-limit evasion, or reselling access without a written agreement. We may throttle or suspend accounts that put the service or other users at risk.

6. Availability

The service depends on third-party model providers and may be interrupted. We do not promise uninterrupted access. Failed generations are refunded; nothing more is owed for downtime.

7. Embedded video

Some free Social Cinema series play through the official YouTube embedded player. YouTube remains the source of those videos, and your use of that player is also governed by the YouTube Terms of Service. We may remove an embedded title if its creator disables embedding or removes the source video.

7A. Social Cinema publication

Approved creators must follow the Cinema Content Policy, choose an accurate Veyrnox audience label, declare relevant content warnings, and submit only files they reasonably believe are safe. Veyrnox labels are guidance and are not official BBFC classifications. Submission does not guarantee publication.

We may automatically inspect metadata, images, sampled video frames, speech or captions and file-safety signals; quarantine a submission; require human review; or reject, restrict, suspend or remove a title. A required safety check must pass before publication. Creators may appeal a decision using the contact route in the Cinema Content Policy.

7B. Cinema Pass

  • A Cinema Pass supplies access to published Social Cinema films and episodes while the Pass is active, subject to the delivered-minute limit displayed before purchase. It adds no Credits.
  • The Pass charges the recurring USD price displayed when you subscribe, plus any tax shown at checkout, and renews automatically each week or month, according to the option you select, until you cancel.
  • You can cancel from the Cinema Pass page or use its Stripe billing portal. Outside the initial cooling-off period, cancellation stops the next renewal and access continues until the displayed paid-period end.
  • If you cancel within 14 days of the first charge, the Pass ends immediately and the unused share of the current paid period is refunded to the original payment method. The page shows when this option is available and the refund is not complete until confirmed.
  • Before checkout you must expressly ask us to start the Pass immediately and acknowledge its automatic renewal and cooling-off treatment.

8. Liability

Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law. Otherwise, our total liability to you in any 12-month period is limited to the amount you paid us in that period. We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss.

9. Consumers

If you are a consumer in the UK or EU, your statutory rights are not affected by these terms.

10. Changes and termination

We may update these terms; material changes will be announced on the site at least 14 days before they take effect. You may close your account at any time. We may terminate for breach with notice where practicable.

11. Law

These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Consumers may also rely on mandatory protections of their home country.

Contact

legal@veyrnox.com

VEYRNOX.ai

Privacy Policy

Veyrnox Ltd, trading as Veyrnox.ai. Company no. 17299951. Last updated 18 October 2026.

Veyrnox Ltd (“we”) is the data controller for personal data processed through Veyrnox.ai. Registered office: Suite RA01, 195-197 Wood Street, London, England, E17 3NU. Contact: privacy@veyrnox.com.

What we collect

  • Account data — email address, authentication identifiers, and if you sign in with Apple or Google, the identifier they share.
  • Usage data — the prompts, chat messages and reference files or images you submit, the generations and chat replies you request, credit balance and ledger history, and job status.
  • Publish data — connected social account details, media you upload, captions, schedules and posting analytics needed to publish to the accounts you select.
  • Technical data — IP address, browser and device information, and request logs needed to keep the service secure.
  • Optional product analytics — if you consent, page paths, button and form interactions, web performance measurements and technical error details. We do not send URL query strings, prompts, chat text, form values, uploaded or generated media, passwords or payment details.
  • Optional session replay — if you separately consent, a privacy-masked reconstruction of up to 100% of eligible browser sessions. All text and inputs are masked; images, video, audio, canvas and iframes are blocked; console output, request or response bodies and headers are not recorded; and replay is disabled on sign-in, account, admin and payment pages.
  • Payment data — credit packs are sold through Stripe Managed Payments, under which Stripe, Inc. is the Merchant of Record and seller of record, and charges and remits any VAT or sales tax. Stripe collects your payment details, billing address and any tax information as its own controller, under its own privacy policy. We receive the payment reference, amount, currency, country and email so we can add the credits to your account. We never see or store full card numbers.

Why we process it

  • To run the service and fulfil your generations (performance of a contract).
  • To keep an accurate credit ledger and prevent abuse (legitimate interests).
  • To meet legal obligations, including tax and content-provenance requirements.
  • To send service messages. We do not send marketing email without consent.
  • With your consent, to understand product use, measure performance and diagnose errors and broken interactions.

Where your data lives

We run on Supabase for the database and authentication, and on Cloudflare for edge hosting and object storage. Account data, credit ledger, generation metadata and your chat conversations sit in our Supabase database, which is hosted in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). Generated media is stored in the European Union, in Cloudflare R2 with an EU jurisdictional restriction. If you consent to optional analytics, analytics, masked replay and error events are processed in PostHog Cloud EU. Your prompts, chat messages and reference files or images are transmitted to the third-party model provider that runs the model you selected, through our model gateway, for the sole purpose of producing your output. For chat we ask the gateway to use only providers that do not store your content or use it to train models. If you switch on Web search, your question is also sent to a web search provider. When Web search runs through our own search, that provider is Exa (exa.ai) or Parallel (parallel.ai), depending on the service configuration. It receives your question as the search query; Parallel also receives a chat conversation identifier and the selected model identifier, and the text of the pages it finds is sent, through our model gateway, to the model provider along with your question so the answer can cite sources.

Some of the companies that process your personal data are outside the United Kingdom and the EEA: our edge hosting, the model providers, and Stripe, Inc. (United States), which is the Merchant of Record for credit pack purchases. Where your personal data is processed outside the United Kingdom or the EEA, we rely on the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses with the company concerned. If we move the database to another region we will update this page before the move takes effect.

YouTube data in Veyrnox.ai Publish

Social Cinema uses YouTube’s privacy-enhanced embedded player for selected free-to-watch series. Before you press play, YouTube receives the technical information needed to display the thumbnail, title, playability and content restrictions. When you play a video, YouTube receives playback and device data and may set or read cookies according to the Google Privacy Policy. We do not download or store a copy of the embedded video.

When you connect a YouTube channel to Veyrnox.ai Publish, we ask Google for permission to identify your channel, read its supported channel and video statistics, and upload the videos you select. This consent is separate from Google sign-in. We use the read access to show your connected channel and basic posting analytics. We use upload access only to carry out your Post now or Schedule post instructions.

We store the connected channel details, granted permissions, posting history and analytics in our Supabase database. Access and refresh tokens are encrypted before storage and used by our server to make the authorized YouTube API calls, including scheduled uploads. Selecting a Library video does not by itself upload it to YouTube. When you post or schedule it, we send the selected video and its title and description to YouTube.

Disconnecting a channel removes its stored access and refresh tokens and stops further publishing and analytics collection for that connection. It does not delete videos already uploaded to YouTube. Account details, posting history and previously collected analytics remain part of your Veyrnox account; you can request their deletion using the contact and data-rights process below. You can also revoke Veyrnox.ai Publish’s access through your Google Account.

We do not use data obtained through the YouTube API to train AI models or for advertising targeting. Veyrnox.ai Publish’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements.

How we protect your data

We use the following safeguards to protect personal data, including sensitive Google user data obtained through the YouTube API, against unauthorized access and disclosure:

  • Encryption in transit — we use HTTPS/TLS to encrypt data sent between your browser and Veyrnox.ai, and between our servers and Google’s APIs and our database.
  • Protection of stored OAuth tokens — YouTube access and refresh tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they are stored in our database. The encryption key is held separately in a server-side secret. Tokens are used by our servers for the features you authorize and are not returned to the browser in connected-account responses.
  • Access controls — our APIs verify your signed-in identity and check that the connected accounts and associated data belong to you. Connected-account and analytics tables use database row-level security, with access through controlled server-side operations rather than direct browser access.

Planned model processor: BytePlus

BytePlus Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) is a planned processor for selected Seedance video models. These models are not currently available on Veyrnox.ai. When enabled, choosing one of these models will send your prompt and any reference images to BytePlus ModelArk in Singapore to generate your video. This processing takes place outside the United Kingdom and the EEA; storing the finished video in our EU storage does not keep the generation processing within those regions.

We will enable these models only after the applicable data-processing and international-transfer arrangements are in place. We will update this notice when the models become available.

Retention

  • Generated media is kept for 90 days, then deleted automatically.
  • Completed Publish uploads stay in your Publish uploads until removed. A file used by a draft, scheduled or in-progress post cannot be removed until that post finishes or is canceled; its metadata remains in the posting history. Abandoned uploads are deleted after 24 hours. Removing an unused file queues its storage deletion after its upload link expires, normally within 20 minutes.
  • Chat conversations are kept until you delete them. Deleting a chat removes it and its messages from our database straight away.
  • Our database is backed up daily and each backup is kept for around seven days, so a chat you delete can remain in a backup for up to that long before it expires.
  • Images you upload to a chat are kept in our storage only long enough to answer, and are deleted within 24 hours. An image you pick from your Library for a chat stays in your Library, and is sent to the model provider to answer. If you choose a video, your browser takes a few still frames from it and those are attached as images; the video itself is not uploaded.
  • Ledger records are kept for as long as your account exists plus the period required by tax law. A chat reply’s entry in your credit history records which model, which options and the Credits charged; it never contains the text of your messages.
  • Request logs are kept for a short security window and then discarded.
  • Optional product analytics and error events are kept for up to 12 months. Optional session replays are kept for up to 30 days. Withdrawing consent stops new collection; you can also ask us to delete existing events linked to your account.

Deleting your account

You can delete your account yourself from Account & security. Deleting it signs you out everywhere and erases your sign-in, your chats, personas and folders, your generated files and the prompts behind them, your Publish connections and their stored access tokens, and your referral code. Credits you have not used are forfeited and nothing is refunded; the screen tells you how many before you confirm. We cannot delete an account while a payment dispute or a content hold is open, while a subscription is active, or while a generation is still running; the screen says which applies.

Some records stay after deletion, with your name and email removed: credit and payment records (kept for the period tax law requires), content reports and appeals, and referral accounting. They are attached to an anonymous identifier, not to you.

To stop deleting and re-registering from restoring the free sign-up Credits, we keep a one-way hash of your email address after you delete. We hold it only for fraud prevention, on the basis of our legitimate interest, and use it for nothing else. Nothing is posted to or removed from networks you published to: revoke Veyrnox.ai’s access in each network’s own settings.

Sharing

We share data only with the companies needed to run the service: authentication and database hosting, edge hosting and storage, PostHog for optional consented analytics and diagnostics, AI model providers and the model gateway that routes requests to them, web search providers when you switch on Web search (Exa or Parallel, when it runs through our own search), Resend for the emails we send about your account, and Stripe, Inc. for credit pack purchases. Stripe, Inc. acts as its own controller for the purchase it makes as Merchant of Record. When you schedule a Publish post, we send its media and caption to the social networks you select. Uploading a file alone does not send it to a social network. We do not sell personal data.

Your rights

You can access, correct, export or delete your data, and object to or restrict certain processing. See GDPR & Data Rights for how. You may also complain to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office or your local supervisory authority.

Cookies

We use cookies and local storage that are strictly necessary to remember your sign-in, preferences and privacy choice and to keep the service working. If you open a friend’s referral link, we keep that link’s code in your browser’s local storage for up to three days so it can be linked to your account when you sign up, then remove it. PostHog analytics storage is off by default and starts only if you choose Analytics only or Analytics & replay. You can change or withdraw that choice at any time with the Privacy choices button. We do not use advertising trackers.

Referrals

If you join through someone’s referral link, we record which account referred yours. That person can see how many friends joined through their link and is never told who you are. If you buy a Credit Pack, they may earn Credits as described in the Terms; the reward is reversed if that purchase is refunded or disputed.

Children

The service is not intended for anyone under 18.

Changes

We will post material changes here and note the date at the top of this page.

Refund Policy

Veyrnox Ltd, trading as Veyrnox.ai. Company no. 17299951. Last updated 16 October 2026.

This page explains refunds for generations, Credit Packs, Credit Subscriptions, the Veyrnox.ai Publish Plan and Cinema Pass.

Failed generations — automatic

Every generation shows its credit cost before you confirm. Credits are debited on submission. If the model provider rejects the job or fails to return a result, the full debit is refunded to your balance automatically, usually within seconds. You do not need to contact us. The refund appears as a separate entry in your ledger.

Completed generations

Once a generation completes and the output is delivered, the credits are spent. We cannot refund completed generations because the underlying model provider has already charged us for the compute.

Free credits

The 10 credits granted on sign-up have no cash value, are not refundable in money, and expire 90 days after they are granted if unused. Purchased credits never expire.

Purchased credits

  • You can request a full refund of a credit pack within 14 days of purchase, as long as you have not generated anything since that purchase. Once you generate after buying, that purchase can no longer be refunded. Refunds go back to the original payment method, and the credits from that pack are removed from your balance.
  • If you are a UK or EU consumer, this does not limit your statutory cancellation rights.
  • If you joined through someone’s referral link, refunding your first credit pack also reverses the referral reward that purchase earned for them. It does not change your refund.

Credit Subscriptions

  • You can stop renewal at any time from Credits & billing. Your current Subscription Credits remain available only until the paid cycle ends; they do not roll over.
  • Within 14 days of the initial subscription payment, you can request immediate cancellation and a full refund if none of that cycle’s Subscription Credits has been used. The cycle’s Credits are removed before the refund is sent to the original payment method.
  • If any Subscription Credits have been used, or the initial 14-day period has ended, the immediate refund option is unavailable. You can still stop the next renewal.
  • A pending or refused refund is not described as complete. The billing screen lets you retry a recoverable request or contact support when operator review is required.

Veyrnox.ai Publish Plan

  • You can stop weekly, monthly or annual renewal from the Publish Plan page or its Stripe billing portal. The Plan continues until the current paid period ends.
  • For a refund request, contact support with your account email and the payment reference. Your statutory rights are not affected.

Cinema Pass

  • You can cancel from the Cinema Pass page or its Stripe billing portal. After the initial cooling-off period, cancellation stops renewal and the Pass continues until the current paid period ends.
  • If you cancel within 14 days of the first charge, the Pass ends immediately and we refund the unused share of that paid period to the original payment method.
  • A refund of a Pass invoice ends that Pass. A payment dispute also ends the Pass and may pause the account while the dispute is reviewed.

How to cancel

Use the self-service cancellation control for the subscription or Pass in your account. You may also email legal@veyrnox.com with the account email, the product you want to cancel and a clear request to cancel. Do not send card details. We will confirm the outcome by email.

Duplicate charges

Submissions are idempotent: the same request is never debited twice. If you believe you were double-charged, send the job reference to legal@veyrnox.com and we will check the ledger.

Abuse

Refund requests that indicate abuse of the free-credit grant or the service may be declined.

documents.aup:
VEYRNOX.ai

Acceptable Use Policy

Veyrnox Ltd, trading as Veyrnox.ai. Company no. 17299951. Last updated 13 October 2026.

Veyrnox.ai turns text prompts and uploaded files into images, video, speech and music, and lets approved creators submit work to Social Cinema. These rules apply to every prompt, upload, output and publication and form part of the Terms. Social Cinema submissions also follow the Cinema Content Policy.

You must have the rights to what you upload

Before you upload a photo, a video or a recording of a voice, you must either own it or have the permission of everyone identifiable in it. When a generation takes an upload, we ask you to confirm that, and we record the confirmation against that job. Confirming it falsely is a breach of these terms.

Prohibited

  • Sexual content. Pornography, sexually explicit material, sexual violence, fetish content or nudity intended to arouse, whether real, fictional, animated or AI-generated.
  • Anything involving minors. No sexualised, exploitative or abusive depiction of a person under 18, real or generated. This includes childlike characters presented as adults. We may report suspected child sexual abuse material and close the account.
  • Impersonation and deepfakes. Using a real person's face, body or voice to make them appear to say or do something they did not, including public figures. We do not offer face-swap or voice-cloning tools, and you may not use the tools we do offer to achieve that result.
  • Non-consensual intimate imagery of anyone, and any sexualised depiction of a real, identifiable person.
  • Deception. Passing AI output off as an authentic photograph or recording of a real event, fake news, fake evidence, fake identity documents, or election disinformation.
  • Harassment and hate. Content that threatens, bullies or degrades a person or group, or promotes violence or a hateful ideology.
  • Illegal activity under UK law or the law where you are, including infringing someone else's copyright or trade mark.
  • Malware and unsafe files. Malware, executable code, macros, scripts, disguised file types, decoder exploits, malicious links or any attempt to compromise another person or the service.
  • Malicious use of the platform. Reselling raw model access, bypassing our rate limits or credit accounting, scraping, or probing our providers' systems.

Labelling AI output

Everything this service produces is AI-generated. If you publish it somewhere that expects real footage, say that it is AI-generated. Some jurisdictions, including the EU under the AI Act, require that disclosure.

How we enforce this

We use provider filters and our own automated and human review. Uploads may be quarantined while content, child-safety and malware checks run. A required check that is missing, unavailable or unresolved does not pass. If we find a breach we may refuse a generation or publication, remove content, suspend or close the account, and keep records where the law requires it. Credits attached to a closed account are not refunded where the closure follows a breach of this policy.

Reporting

To report content or an account, email legal@veyrnox.com with the link or job reference. We answer reports about a real person depicted without consent first.

Changes

We update this policy as the service changes. The date at the top of the page is the version in force.

documents.cinema-content:
VEYRNOX.ai

Cinema Content Policy

Veyrnox Ltd, trading as Veyrnox.ai. Company no. 17299951. Last updated 13 October 2026.

This policy applies to every title, episode, poster, subtitle, audio track, description and other file submitted to Social Cinema. It is part of our Terms and Acceptable Use Policy.

Content we do not allow

  • Sexual content: pornography, explicit sexual acts, nudity intended to arouse, fetish content, sexual violence or sexual exploitation.
  • Children: any sexualised, exploitative or abusive depiction of a person under 18, whether real, fictional, animated or AI-generated. Apparent age matters; labelling a character as an adult does not make a childlike depiction acceptable.
  • Intimate images: non-consensual intimate imagery, sexual deepfakes, or sexualised depictions of an identifiable real person.
  • Severe harm: content that promotes terrorism, hate, suicide, self-harm, eating disorders, dangerous acts or serious crime; credible threats; or graphic cruelty presented for gratification.
  • Deception and abuse: impersonation, scams, fake evidence, malicious links, privacy violations, harassment or content that infringes another person's rights.
  • Unsafe files: malware, executable code, macros, scripts, disguised file types, corrupted media intended to exploit a decoder, or links intended to compromise a viewer or the service.

Veyrnox audience labels

Creators must choose a label and declare every applicable content warning. These are Veyrnox guidance labels, not official BBFC classifications or BBFC symbols.

  • All ages: mild, reassuring material suitable for a general audience.
  • PG: some scenes may be unsuitable for younger or sensitive children; parental guidance is advised.
  • 12+: moderate threat, violence, language or mature themes.
  • 15+: strong language, violence, horror, drug references or mature themes.
  • 18+: strong adult themes or violence that remains within this policy. An 18+ label never permits prohibited sexual content.

Review before publication

Submissions remain private while automated systems examine metadata, images, sampled video frames, speech or captions, file structure and malware signals. A submission may be sent to a trained reviewer. Automated checks can be wrong, so they assist rather than replace human decisions for uncertain cases.

We may reject, restrict, suspend or remove content, preserve an audit record, and restrict or close accounts for serious or repeated breaches. We may report suspected illegal content where required by law. We do not publish a title when a required check is missing, unavailable or unresolved.

Reports and appeals

Report a title or ask us to review a decision at legal@veyrnox.com. Include the title link and a short explanation. Do not email illegal imagery or suspected malware.

GDPR & Data Rights

Veyrnox Ltd, trading as Veyrnox.ai. Company no. 17299951. Last updated 18 October 2026.

Veyrnox Ltd processes personal data under the UK GDPR and, for EU residents, the EU GDPR. This page explains how to exercise your rights.

Your rights

  • Access — a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Rectification — correction of inaccurate data.
  • Erasure — deletion of your account and personal data, subject to records we must keep by law (for example ledger entries needed for tax). You can delete your account yourself from Account & security; see what is erased and what stays.
  • Portability — your account data, generation metadata and chat conversations in a machine-readable format.
  • Restriction and objection — for processing based on legitimate interests.
  • Withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent.

How to make a request

Email privacy@veyrnox.com from the address on your account. We respond within one month; complex requests may take up to two further months and we will tell you if so. Requests are free unless manifestly unfounded or excessive.

Where data is processed

Our database, which holds account data, the credit ledger, generation metadata and chat conversations, is hosted in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). Generated media is stored in the European Union, in Cloudflare R2 with an EU jurisdictional restriction. Model providers may process your prompt and reference files outside the UK or EEA for the duration of the generation. For every transfer outside the UK or EEA we rely on the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses with the processor concerned.

Automated decisions

We do not make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about you solely by automated means. Content-safety filtering may block a generation; you can ask us to review a block.

Content provenance

We do not currently embed content credentials or provenance metadata in generated files, so no personal data of yours is carried inside an output by us. A model provider may embed its own watermark or identifier; that is outside our control and we do not add one on top.

Complaints

UK: Information Commissioner’s Office, ico.org.uk. EU: your local supervisory authority. We would appreciate the chance to resolve any concern first.

Controller details

Veyrnox Ltd · Company no. 17299951 · Suite RA01, 195-197 Wood Street, London, England, E17 3NU
